description: Per-component CLI contract conformance results (Plan 018 WI-2). Separate from the frozen v1 feature matrix by design (Sol review): this tracks the horizontal contract effort. A component is recorded here only when the kit runs green in its CI.

agent-suite.evidence: tests/test_cli_conformance.py in agent-suite CI (lint-and-test job); WI-026 meta-guard: assert_cases_declared dogfooded here + tests/test_conformance_meta_guard.py proves the gate runs (not skips)
agent-suite.notes: Wheel lane (P1) not yet wired. dry-run exit-2 convention resolved: codex-plugins dry-run now exits 0. kit 1.1.0 adds assert_cases_declared (additive; family adoption is a per-repo pin bump + helper call).

regista.evidence: tests/test_cli_conformance.py in regista CI (check job, py3.13/3.14); regista PR #9
regista.notes: Adoption surfaced and fixed two contract §5 traceback defects (workflow validate on a missing file; RegistaError escaping Regista() construction). Kit consumed as pinned agent-suite-conformance==1.0.0 (Plan 019 B1); CI matrix moved to 3.13/3.14 (kit requires >=3.12). Hermetic cases declared non-DB so the conftest DSN-substring skip heuristic doesn't silently skip the gate in CI.

agent-notes.evidence: tests/test_cli_conformance.py in agent-notes CI (check job, py3.13/3.14); agent-notes PR #10
agent-notes.notes: Clean adoption — no CLI fixes required; the earlier P0 envelope conversion already held. Keeps decision-52 exit codes (2/3/4); kit checks version-independent contract invariants.

agent-provenance.evidence: agent-provenance PR #9; main CI run https://github.com/hraedon/agent-provenance/actions/runs/30604219970 (source Python 3.13/3.14 and clean built-wheel jobs)
agent-provenance.notes: Kit 1.1.0 meta-guards prove the gate collects non-empty success, error, and usage dimensions without whole-module skips. The clean wheel lane installs the artifact with the published kit outside the source tree.

agent-capability-broker.evidence: agent-capability-broker PR #19; main CI run https://github.com/hraedon/agent-capability-broker/actions/runs/30604219868 (non-skipping source gate on Python 3.12/3.13/3.14 and Windows)
agent-capability-broker.notes: Kit 1.1.0 meta-guards enforce non-empty case dimensions and reject a whole-module skip. A clean built-wheel lane is configured for release tags, as required by CLI contract section 7; no wheel pass is claimed before a release-tag run. Act-path exit-code reclassification is explicitly deferred to agent-suite WI-032.

dossier.evidence: dossier PR #9; main CI run https://github.com/hraedon/dossier/actions/runs/30604220022 (source Python 3.13/3.14, Windows, and clean built-wheel jobs)
dossier.notes: Kit 1.1.0 meta-guards prove non-empty case dimensions and reject whole-module skips. The wheel tests assert imports and console entry points resolve from the installed artifact without source shadowing.

agent-wake.evidence: agent-wake PR #8; main CI run https://github.com/hraedon/agent-wake/actions/runs/30604220008 (source Python 3.11/3.12 and clean built-wheel jobs)
agent-wake.notes: Kit 1.1.0 runs on the supported Python 3.12 lane while runtime support remains Python 3.11+.
